name: Mirae Asset Securities Co. Ltd.
summary: Mirae Asset Securities Co., Ltd. operates as a prominent financial investment firm, serving clients both in South Korea and globally. The company's operations are structured across key segments: Wealth Management (WM), Investment Banking (IB), Sales & Trading, and Principal Investment (PI) & Others. Its diverse offerings encompass general securities brokerage, comprehensive wealth management, and expert financial consulting. The Investment Banking division is instrumental in managing initial public offerings (IPOs), providing various corporate financing solutions—including pre-IPO investments, capital increases, rights offerings, as well as the issuance of equity-linked, corporate, and global bonds—and overseeing private equity fund management services. Additionally, it offers M&A advisory, structured finance, credit exposure solutions, and leveraged financing, alongside issuing, underwriting, investing in, and extending credit for asset-backed securities. Beyond investment banking, the company is actively involved in bond dealing and brokerage, hedge fund management, principal investment, and proprietary trading. It also issues equity-linked warrants and exchange-traded notes, and supplies derivatives. Further services include pension planning, a broad spectrum of financial products such as mutual funds, ELS/DLS, derivatives-linked securities, debt securities, equities, trusts, and wrap accounts, complemented by asset management services. The firm also delivers advisory services covering tax, real estate, legal, investment, and insurance, offers guidance on real estate project financing, and provides digital finance solutions. Furthermore, Mirae Asset Securities engages in real estate investment and leasing activities. Founded in 1970 and based in Seoul, South Korea, the company was known as Mirae Asset Daewoo Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to Mirae Asset Securities Co., Ltd. in March 2021. As of December 31, 2020, the firm maintained a network of 77 domestic branches and three international liaison offices.
